# ResumeRadar
> Free ATS resume scanner — no signup required

ResumeRadar is a free online tool that helps job seekers check their resume against a specific job description. Upload a resume (PDF/DOCX) and paste a job description to get a keyword match estimate, missing keywords by category, ATS formatting checks, and AI-powered improvement suggestions.

## Features
- Keyword match estimate with keyword analysis across 5 categories (technical skills, soft skills, certifications, education, action verbs)
- Missing keyword detection against the actual job description
- AI-powered resume suggestions, quick wins, and cover-letter talking points
- Free cover letter generator
- ATS formatting and recruiter-tips sub-scores

## Pricing
- Free. No signup, no payment.

## Role-specific checkers
Free ATS resume checkers with keyword guides for 15 roles, at
https://resumeradar.sholastechnotes.com/ats-resume-checker/ — including
software engineer, data analyst, cloud engineer, DevOps engineer, data
scientist, product manager, project manager, UX designer, cybersecurity
analyst, business analyst, solutions architect, frontend developer,
backend developer, scrum master, and machine learning engineer.

## URL
https://resumeradar.sholastechnotes.com

## Privacy
Your CV file is deleted as soon as it is read. Your CV text is sent to our AI provider to write your suggestions and is not saved by ResumeRadar. Results are cached for up to one hour, and nothing is sold. Details: https://resumeradar.sholastechnotes.com/privacy

## What the score means
The score is a keyword match estimate. It is not an employer's ATS score, an applicant ranking or a prediction of interviews or job offers.
